# Provenance notice — CMSclassifier

This directory bundles a third-party R package, vendored (copied) because the
upstream source is no longer reachable.

- **Package:** CMSclassifier
- **Purpose:** prediction of the Consensus Molecular Subtype (CMS) of colorectal
  carcinomas from gene expression profiles.
- **Original authors:** Aurelien de Reynies, Justin Guinney
- **Original maintainers' contact (as listed in DESCRIPTION):**
  reyniesa@ligue-cancer.net, justin.guinney@sagebase.org
- **Original repository:** `github.com/Sage-Bionetworks/CMSclassifier`
  (returns HTTP 404 as of 2026-10-12 — no longer available; no mirror or fork
  was found at the time of this check)
- **Commit fetched:** `ba02ec5c88194e34c2a2b6a0c81bc07c36c8e9fa` (per `RemoteSha`
  in `DESCRIPTION`)
- **License (as declared in the package's own `DESCRIPTION`):** `GPL`
  (no specific version pinned by the upstream author; no separate LICENSE
  file was shipped with the package)
- **Dependency:** `randomForest` (CRAN), licensed `GPL-2 | GPL-3`

Because the upstream repository is gone, this vendored copy is kept in this
repository as the only remaining accessible source. No claim of authorship
is made over this package; it is preserved as received.
